description: Quantifies the spurious charge-asymmetry of the per-generator brane tower for the A=3 mirror pair (³H/³He): Δtower = tower(³He) − tower(³H) > 0 favors the proton-rich member, OPPOSITE to the physical split (³He less bound). At the canonical E₀ = m_e/(q₀(q₀−1)) scale the asymmetry is the same order as the 0.76 MeV Coulomb split. No fit; production |V̂_i^full|, CAL-1 m_e, derived q₀. EXPLORATORY.

parameters.E0_def: m_e/(q_0 (q_0 − 1)), CAL-1 m_e, canonical per-block scale
parameters.scale_caveat: per-generator-tower → binding wiring is the z-Habiro hypothesis verdicted non-production in PR #2467; E0·Δtower is a cross-model order-of-magnitude figure, not a binding prediction.

assertions.name: tower_asymmetry_favors_He3
assertions.note: Δtower = tower(³He) − tower(³H) > 0 (tower over-binds the proton-rich member)

assertions.name: asymmetry_opposes_physical_split
assertions.note: tower asymmetry sign opposes AME (³He less bound) — spurious

assertions.name: asymmetry_same_order_as_coulomb_split
assertions.note: E₀·Δtower ≳ 0.1×(T−³He split): not a negligible correction
